# **Defect 02 \- Update or Edit First Name or Last Name Fields**

**Module**: Employee List \-\> Employee Detail  
**Severity**: Major   
**Priority**: Medium  
**Status**: Open  
**Environment**: Chrome, Windows 11

### **Description**

Verify that employee profile changes are saved successfully after editing

### **Steps-to-Reproduce**

1. Login to [https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login](https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login)   
2. Navigate to Employee List \-\> Employee Detail  
3. Type:  
   Before   
   First name: “didi 🙌”  
   Last name: “dudu 😄”  
   After   
   First Name: “didi hei”  
   Last Name: “dudu hui”  
4. Click ‘Save’ button  
5. View employee data

### **Expected Result** 

The system successfully updated the newly made changes in real time.

### **Actual Result**

The system doesn’t update the employee information.
